signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {E₁ : Type u_2} -> {E₂ : Type u_3} -> {E₃ : Type u_4} -> [Semiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid E₁] -> [PartialOrder E₁] -> [AddCommMonoid E₂] -> [PartialOrder E₂] -> [AddCommMonoid E₃] -> [PartialOrder E₃] -> [Module R E₁] -> [Module R E₂] -> [Module R E₃] -> (g : E₂ →ₚ[R] E₃) -> (f : E₁ →ₚ[R] E₂) -> E₁ →ₚ[R] E₃

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.comp is a total constructor on well-typed positive linear maps; every valid input produces a meaningful composite positive linear map with no junk-value conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (R E₁ E₂ E₃ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid E₁] [PartialOrder E₁] [AddCommMonoid E₂] [PartialOrder E₂] [AddCommMonoid E₃] [PartialOrder E₃] [Module R E₁] [Module R E₂] [Module R E₃] (g : E₂ →ₚ[R] E₃) (f : E₁ →ₚ[R] E₂) (x y : E₁), VTask.comp g f (x + y) = VTask.comp g f x + VTask.comp g f y

facts.statement: ∀ (R E₁ E₂ E₃ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid E₁] [PartialOrder E₁] [AddCommMonoid E₂] [PartialOrder E₂] [AddCommMonoid E₃] [PartialOrder E₃] [Module R E₁] [Module R E₂] [Module R E₃] (g : E₂ →ₚ[R] E₃) (f : E₁ →ₚ[R] E₂) (r : R) (x : E₁), VTask.comp g f (r • x) = r • VTask.comp g f x
